title: Sean-Nós Dance Back to Basics: The Connemara Step

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down variations step by step, explaining weight shifts and variations clearly. She demonstrates each movement from a back view on a wooden dance floor.

lesson_structure.note: First version breakdown: two heel scuffs and a toe tap
Second version breakdown: stomp and hop transition
Third version breakdown: three heel scuffs and a hop
Fourth version breakdown: heel drop before toe tap

Practicing steps with fast tempo music
